component_findings.learning_materials: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-3--typescript): Independent tutorial and reference material for TypeScript is abundant and actively produced (e.g. dedicated freeCodeCamp long-form guides walking through the most common Stack Overflow TypeScript questions), indicating a mature secondary layer of public knowledge beyond official docs.
component_findings.qa_discussion: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-3--typescript): TypeScript ships an official, actively maintained Handbook and reference documentation at typescriptlang.org/docs, covering language fundamentals through advanced type-system features; this is the canonical first-party knowledge source referenced throughout the wider ecosystem (e.g. tutorial sites explicitly point learners back to the official Handbook for interfaces-vs-types guidance).

metric.community_public_knowledge_availa.limitations: GitHub contributor/repository counts are raw activity/popularity indicators and are used here only as one of four declared corroborating signals, not as the sole basis for the score. | An exact current Stack Overflow 'typescript' tag question-count could not be retrieved via search in this session (aggregator/scraper listing pages dominated results instead of the live tag page); the Developer Survey usage-share and GitHub Octoverse figures are used as the primary quantitative substitutes, consistent with the predeclared multi-signal rule. | Survey percentages are self-reported and opt-in, so absolute magnitudes are directional rather than exact.
metric.community_public_knowledge_availa.selection_rule: Inspect the same knowledge channels for every language and use current, publicly accessible evidence rather than raw search-result counts alone.
